Known for his unique offbeat rapping style, Blueface quickly became one of the most recognizable personalities in West Coast hip-hop. Beyond music, he has gained widespread attention through his relationships, social media controversies, and livestreaming career. He shares two children, Javaughn and Journey, with his former fiancée Jaidyn Alexis. 

Jaidyn Alexis is a 28-year-old rapper, entrepreneur, and social media personality from Los Angeles, California. She initially gained recognition through her longtime relationship with Blueface, whom she reportedly met during high school. The two share two children and have experienced an on-and-off relationship throughout the years. Jaidyn eventually launched her own music career under Blueface’s MILF Music label, gaining attention with songs including “Stewie” and “Barbie.” In October 2023, Blueface famously proposed to Jaidyn inside a luxury suite during a Los Angeles Rams game at SoFi Stadium, presenting her with a massive diamond ring. The emotional proposal quickly went viral, but the couple eventually separated. Despite their complicated history, both remain connected through their children and shared history in the entertainment industry.
